title: How credit unions and fintech can work together
summary: Turnkey digital experiences. Fully customizable front-end experiences that can be tailored to your design system. Developer-friendly APIs.
body_markdown:
> ***Watch the interview directly on PYMNTS***[here](https://www.pymnts.com/credit-unions/2022/credit-unions-fintechs-warm-up-to-collaboration-instead-of-competition/) ***.***


Credit unions (CUs) and fintechs are increasingly collaborating to navigate the digital financial landscape. In this interview, Atomic CEO David Dindi joined other experts to discuss the topic on PYMNTS TV, a recognized global leader for data, news and insights on the connected economy. Dindi highlighted how companies like Atomic can offer capabilities for financial institutions to layer new features on top of existing value propositions, while the FIs continue to manage the direct relationship with their respective end-customers. The goal, he said, is “to eliminate the barriers and the obstacles that make it difficult for credit unions to be able to offer a service like investing — where the cost/income ratio is favorable for the CU.”
